parole.testo: Variant of -at, seen in toponyms such as Qesarat, Kastrat, Dukat, Progonat, Bushat. The [-t] and [-s] are both from similar Proto-Albanian *tāi and Proto-Albanian *tjā. An Illyrian derivation.

Seen in toponyms such as Qesarat, Kastrat, Dukat, Progonat Bushat. The [-t] as [-s] as both from similar Proto-Albanian *tāi and Proto-Albanian *tjā. Toponym is considered a preservation of Illyrian *-atāi, attested in [Labeatai], [Docleatae], [Autoriatae], [Delmatae]. See -të

parole.significato: oak; a tree of genus Quercus.
parole.testo: According to Jokl, from an Illyrian [Term?] substrate. According to Orel, from archaic and dialectal drushk, from Proto-Albanian *druška, from *druwa (“tree”) (modern dru). More at dru.
